name: domain-review
title: Domain authentication review
for_each: select id,name from domains order by name

sections.title: Sources
sections.sql: select domain,ip,service,decision,messages_30d,failures_30d,review_by from source_health where domain=(select name from domains where id=$1)

sections.title: Investigations
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due,status,outcome from investigations where domain_id=$1

name: investigation-record
title: Authentication investigation record
for_each: select id,code from investigations order by code
